description: Deterministic PreToolUse gates backing 5 approved Major findings from docs/superpowers/reports/2026-07-13-skill-gap-triage.md: blocking install commands, direct GitHub CLI writes (including auto-merge and gh api field-flag implicit writes), warning (not blocking) on git push when the outward-artifact-preflight provenance scan flags a candidate, and Write calls that would overwrite an existing issue/PR/MR template. Also backs issue #413 (sub-issue of #357): blocking a new-issue-creation tool call whose body lacks an Acceptance Criteria Map or an explicit waiver. Also backs issue #517 (refs #285, #300): blocking a create/update_pull_request call carrying a PR body that, given a local diff touching skills/*/SKILL.md, lacks skill-audit disclosure evidence.
